description: How a convertible note converts in a priced round: accrued interest, conversion price (cap vs discount), shares received and effective discount. Use safe_conversion for SAFEs, which have no interest. Interactive version: https://raziel.co/tools/convertible-note-calculator

discount_pct.description: Discount to the round price in percent. 0 means no discount.

interest_mode.description: How interest accrues: simple, compounded annually, or compounded monthly.

priced_round_pre_money_usd.description: Pre-money valuation of the priced round.

round_price_per_share_usd.description: Price per share paid by new investors in the round.
